  • Advantages and disadvantages of photofacial
  • Photofacial downtime and side effects
  • Flow of treatment
  • Photofacial cost

What is Photofacial “M22”?

This is a treatment that uses IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) to irradiate a wide area of the face to resolve various skin problems and concerns.
At our hospital, we have introduced the latest photofacial "M22" from Luminous. With 7 types of IPL, you can select the appropriate wavelength according to your skin condition and concerns.
It is effective for a wide variety of skin problems and concerns, including age spots and freckles, melasma, redness, acne and acne scars, and enlarged pores. In addition, you can experience better results by repeating the treatment several times.

Effects of photofacial

Are you having trouble with these symptoms?

  • Spots and freckles have become noticeable
  • Concerned about sagging and fine wrinkles?
  • I want to cure acne and acne scars
  • I want to get rid of the dullness of my skin, I want my skin to look clearer
  • I'm worried about my pores opening
  • I want to improve my red face
  • I want to get rid of bumps on my back and décolleté.

When can I feel the effects?

The timing at which the effects appear varies slightly between individuals, ranging from immediately after the treatment to several days after the treatment.
It is recommended to continue irradiation once a month for 4 to 5 times.

Advantages and disadvantages of photofacial

Benefits

Can respond to a wide range of skin problems and concerns

It can be expected to improve and eliminate a wide range of skin problems and concerns, including age spots, freckles, melasma, redness, acne and acne scars, enlarged pores, and bumpy areas on the back and décolletage.

less pain

The intensity of the light is evened out, which reduces pain.

Almost no downtime

There will be some slight redness immediately after the treatment, but you can wear light makeup immediately afterward and go home.

Treatment time is short

The treatment time is approximately 40 minutes for the entire face and approximately 30 minutes for both cheeks.

Higher effects can be expected with continued treatment

If you continue to use it at a pace of about once a month, you will get better results.

Disadvantages

Hidden stains come to the surface

Temporarily, melanin in the skin layer comes to the surface. Therefore, please be careful about your work/private schedule after the treatment.
After that, the melanin forms a scab and peels off within 2 to 7 days.

Difficult to feel the effect after just one use

Especially if you are looking to improve stains, it is difficult to see the effects in just one treatment.
Multiple treatments are often required.

You cannot tan before or after the treatment.

It is not possible to irradiate the skin immediately after sunburn, or to tan the skin after irradiation.
Before and after your treatment, please protect yourself from UV rays by wearing sunscreen, a parasol, and a hat. Particularly after surgery, careful precautions are required.

Photofacial downtime and side effects

We will explain the downtime, side effects, and risks of photofacials.

Side effects/risks

There will be temporary redness and flushing, but the treatment will cool down after the treatment and you can return home after the treatment has subsided.

Downtime and precautions

Treatment time: about 30-40 minutes
Downtime: Almost none *There are individual differences

  • It is not possible to irradiate the skin immediately after sunburn.
  • After your treatment, please protect yourself from UV rays by using sunscreen cream, a parasol, and a hat, and moisturize your skin.
  • There is almost no downtime, but after the treatment, melanin in the skin layer will temporarily appear on the skin surface. It will then form a scab and fall off in 2 to 7 days.

Flow of treatment

1counseling

A doctor will provide counseling. We will take a look at your skin condition and discuss your wishes.
We will also explain side effects, risks, downtime, precautions, etc.

2face wash

You will be asked to wash your face to remove makeup, sebum, and dirt from the air.

3application of gel

Apply a gel to help the IPL penetrate further.

4IPL irradiation

Apply IPL. Irradiation time is approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

5cooling of the skin

Apply IPL. Irradiation time is approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

6Go home

You can check the condition of your skin, apply makeup, and go home.
